channel.description: Latest articles from The Greymouth Star (greystar.co.nz)

item.title: $5 million comes to the Coast
item.description: A Greymouth Lotto player had a Valentines Day to remember after waking up yesterday $5.08 million richer, sharing the $15 million Powerball jackpot. The post $5 million comes to the Coast appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: Proposal to close Quay for new library green space
item.description: The Grey District Council is proposing to permanently transform part of Richmond Quay into a pedestrian mall in front of the new Greymouth Library by closing part of the street. PICTURE: Grey District Council The post Proposal to close Quay for new library green space appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: Coast booked out for Year of the Horse
item.description: Chinese New Year has delivered a second wave of summer tourism to the West Coast, with accommodation booked out, rental cars snapped up and tour buses rolling. The post Coast booked out for Year of the Horse appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: New kiwi chick welcomed to Paparoa
item.description: Cousins Harlow O’Connor, of Moonlight, and Stella Loveridge, of Ngahere, were captivated looking at the new kiwi chick Mawhero during an open day with the Paparoa Wildlife Trust at the Atarau Kiwi Sanctuary on Saturday PICTURE: Lynne Berry The post New kiwi chick welcomed to Paparoa appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: Kings crowned T20 champs
item.description: Kings have secured a long-awaited West Coast senior T20 title, producing a measured yet determined performance to defeat Got the Runs on Saturday at Arthur Fong Park, in Greymouth. PICTURE: Bill Phillips, DiGiSPORT The post Kings crowned T20 champs appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: New roof caps Sallies makeover
item.description: Accurate Roofing director Mike Carr outside the Salvation Army church and hall in Shakespeare Street, Greymouth, during a major project to replace the roof of the historic building. The post New roof caps Sallies makeover appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: Coast Iranian draws hope from war
item.description: For Nas White, an Iranian-born resident of Kumara, the recent Israeli and US strikes on Iran have stirred a mix of relief, fear, and reflection on decades of family persecution. The post Coast Iranian draws hope from war appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: Ocean search widened
item.description: An aerial search continues today in rough sea conditions for a kayaker believed to have been swept out to the sea off Blaketown on Saturday evening. PICTURE: Dwayne Detlaff The post Ocean search widened appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: Tables stripped from pub
item.description: A small West Coast pub has sparked a social media storm after two outdoor tables were removed over licensing rules, infuriating Blackball locals. The post Tables stripped from pub appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: Library fitout advances
item.description: Greymouth’s new library development is entering its final stages of construction, with interior fitout under way and Unichem Olsen’s Pharmacy confirmed as the first commercial tenant, with opening planned for mid-June. The post Library fitout advances appeared first on Greymouth Star.
